items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: Well, I never did get all your nephews straight. How many of them play music and all that? We have Clement, Tavon, Drum, and bass.

ctx.x: Yeah. I think he played a job or two here on the bass. And if he went to California, he took up a band shift, a ghetto, a ghetto and a bass. And I was told that he was playing older than good. How long did you stay on Harbridge Street? I don't remember. I must have stayed there about five or six years. And when did you move to? I don't remember where I moved from then. Well, I never did get all your nephews straight. How many of them play music and all that? We have Clement, Tavon, Drum, and bass. Paul Eugene,…
He's your nephew? Yeah. What does he play like?
